capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: CoreWeave Denton TX; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 0.0. Construction start - The [Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation](https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/TABS/Search/Print/TABS2025005706) reports Core Scientific is converting existing Bitcoin mining buildings into AI data centers, planning to build AROUND the existing Denton Energy Center.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: CoreWeave Denton TX; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 1.0. First 8 MW billable tranche dedicated to AI [starts running at the site](https://investors.corescientific.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001628280-25-023161/q12025corescientificinc-ea.htm), with another 40 scheduled by the end of the quarter.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: CoreWeave Denton TX; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 3.0. Half the campus energized. 67 billable MW [are now dedicated](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_68280da94b2098ec46fcbe3f4628ea40/corescientific/db/1085/11265/presentation/Q4+FY25+earnings+deck+vfinal.2+PDF.pdf) to CoreWeave's GPUs across three buildings.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: CoreWeave Denton TX; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 4.0. Buildings 1-3 (Denton North) are largely built out/operational, and Denton South has its first data hall plus support equipment substantially installed. Remaining Denton South buildings (4-7) still under construction. This is according to satellite imagery.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: CoreWeave Denton TX; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 4.0. capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: CoreWeave Denton TX; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 7.0. Buildings 1-7 are operational and running, with no construction work visible. capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: QTS Richmond 1; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 0.0. Building 1 and 2 retrofitting has begun (see [Google Earth](https://earth.google.com/web/@37.48913637,-77.24705465,44.31788662a,1464.06665017d,30.00094375y,3.66969189h,0t,0r/data=ChYqEAgBEgoyMDIzLTExLTAyGAFCAggBMikKJwolCiExWVNYSWZQZkcydXVMYm1nUDkyc2NObE1QenF1VGRVV2cgAToDCgEwQgIIAEoICMOJgf0CEAE)). Building 1 has chillers added to the roof and perimeter, and backup generators added to the perimeter.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: QTS Richmond 1; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 1.0. Building 1 (retrofitted) is operational. This is based on it looking complete, and cooling towers possibly showing water vapor plumes, in this [Google Earth image](https://earth.google.com/web/@37.4875167,-77.24806799,43.67572425a,2395.6622579d,30.00094375y,3.66969189h,0t,0r/data=ChYqEAgBEgoyMDI0LTAyLTA2GAFCAggBMikKJwolCiExWVNYSWZQZkcydXVMYm1nUDkyc2NObE1QenF1VGRVV2cgAToDCgEwQgIIAEoICMOJgf0CEAE). Building 2 has chillers added to the roof and perimeter, and backup generators added to the perimeter. Cooling towers near Building 2 have been removed.  Building 3 shell is under construction.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: QTS Richmond 1; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 2.0. Building 2 (retrofitted) is operational. This is based on Building 2 looking compelte, and construction around Building 1 and 2 being mostly cleared. A colored motion artifact on one of the Building 1 cooling tower fans suggests it is moving. Building 3 cooling is installed, backup generators partly installed. Building 4 shell is under construction.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: QTS Richmond 1; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 3.0. Building 3 is operational, based on the building looking complete and the carpark to the south being full. Building 4 has cooling and backup generators fully installed. Building 5 has cooling installed, and backup generators partly installed.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: Google Storey County; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 1.0. Building 1, which was first operational in 2021, has increased power capacity by about 75%. This is based on the expansion of the dry cooling array from 4 to 7 columns (seen on [Google Earth](https://earth.google.com/web/@39.4948785,-119.43174359,1568.8659293a,562.69639351d,35y,-0h,0t,0r/)). Its backup generators also grew from 18 to 33, an 83% increase. Around this time (2023 Q3) the quarterly PUE of the campus is 1.24, down from the initial 1.29 in 2022 Q3. Since no other buildings have been added, these changes indicate an increase in power density, which may entail a new generation of hardware getting installed.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: Google Storey County; Power (MW); projection
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch projection, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 3.0. Building 3 is estimated to be operational. We estimate the operational date by analogy to the time that Building 1 took to go from a foundation to being operational. capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: CoreWeave Ellendale ND; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 0.0. CoreWeave signed the first lease package for 250 MW. No buildings online yet. This is according to an [SEC 8-k filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1144879/000164117225013199/form8-k.htm) from this date.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: CoreWeave Ellendale ND; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 0.0. [A new 150 MW lease](https://ir.applieddigital.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/128/applied-digital-finalizes-additional-150mw-lease-with) brings CoreWeave to 400 MW total contracted. The project is now clearly scheduled to be a three-building CoreWeave campus.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: CoreWeave Ellendale ND; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 1.0. The first 50 MW slice of Building 1 has reached Ready for Service status according to [this report](https://ir.applieddigital.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/133/applied-digital-achieves-ready-for-service-for-phase-1-at). This is the first point where we would count any CoreWeave capacity as operational.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: CoreWeave Ellendale ND; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 1.0. [This Applied Digital report](https://ir.applieddigital.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/137/applied-digital-completes-phase-ii-ready-for-service-at) says the rest of Building 1 has reached Ready for Service, bringing the first building to its expected 100 MW. We can treat this as the first completed data center building.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: CoreWeave Ellendale ND; Power (MW); reported estimate

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: Core42 Lake Mariner; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 1.0. Building 1 is operational. Based on Terawulf [saying](https://investors.terawulf.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/126/terawulf-reports-third-quarter-2025-results) "As of September 30, 2025, the site has energized 245 MW of Bitcoin-mining capacity and 22.5 MW of HPC capacity." The small "Wulf Den" building was [said](https://investors.terawulf.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/99/terawulf-to-deliver-over-70-mw-of-data-center) to be 2 MW of IT power while CB-1 would be 16 MW. This is roughly consistent with 22.5 MW of total facility power. This building is [leased](https://investors.terawulf.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/99/terawulf-to-deliver-over-70-mw-of-data-center) to Core42, a subsidiary of UAE-based G42. It likely uses NVIDIA DGX B200 servers.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: Microsoft-Nebius New Jersey; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 0.0. By mid-December 2025 the building was still not complete. A satellite analysis by SemiAnalysis found that the air-cooled chillers serving the second half of the first 50 MW phase were not yet installed, so the phase was not yet operational. SemiAnalysis estimated the full 50 MW would be reached around January to February 2026.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: Microsoft-Nebius New Jersey; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 1.0. High-resolution satellite imagery shows the air-cooled chiller array has grown to roughly 30 units, enough to support the first phase. We estimate Building 1 became operational around early 2026 with about 50 MW of IT capacity (70 MW total facility power at a 1.4 PUE), based on DataOne's disclosure of a first 50 MW phase. SemiAnalysis estimated the full 50 MW was reached around January to February 2026 ([SemiAnalysis](https://newsletter.semianalysis.com/p/stop-saying-half-of-2026-us-datacenter)); this April image is our first high-resolution confirmation that the cooling is in place.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: Stream Phoenix; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 1.0. Estimated: AI building 1 should be operational. Major construction work finished by January 31, 2026, and the shell looked complete by that date. We estimate after three months the building will be operational.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: Stream Phoenix; Power (MW); projection
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch projection, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 6.0. Although official [promotional sources](https://www.streamdatacenters.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/SDC-Goodyear-CaseStudy-251218.pdf) estimate the campus to be fully operational in 10-12 years, it is likely to be finished sooner than this given the empirical durations for other data center campuses as well as because AI building 6 has been expedited. The first AI building took approximately 24 months to complete. Assuming construction for a new building starts midway for every building, then the campus will be complete in 4 years for the 5 remaining buildings, since AI buildings 2 and 6 are both underway.

capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 0.0. Land clearing begins for Building 1 (SIN01)

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: Start Campus Sines Data Campus; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 0.0. Building 1 (SIN01) is completed, but at this point it likely not being used for AI as the collaboration with Microsoft that resulted in GB300s did not occur until Q1 2026. The completion is based both on satellite imagery, which shows the building fully completed, and a [March 2025 article](https://econews.pt/2025/03/24/start-campus-to-start-construction-of-second-data-centre-building-in-sines-by-end-june/) that says it "has been in operation since October", which is October of 2024.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: Start Campus Sines Data Campus; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 1.0. Building 1 (SIN01) operational for AI, with the first deployment of 12,600 Nvidia GB300 NVL72s to the site being reported completed "Q1 2026" based on the [corporate announcement](https://lp.startcampus.pt/start-campus-hosts-eus-first-nvidia-gb300-chips-with-nscale-for-microsoft). Land clearing also begins for Building 2 (SIN02), with faint dirt outlines for roads and building foundations visible.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: Start Campus Sines Data Campus; Power (MW); projection
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch projection, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 2.0. Building 2 (SIN02) projected to be operational. This is based on the timeline provided in the [factsheet](https://23712035.hs-sites.com/hubfs/SINES_02.PDF.pdf?hsCtaAttrib=199407154715) for the site. We expect VR200 GPUs to be used as a lot of those chips will have already been available in September 2027, and the "up to 600kW racks" in the factsheet suggest they are aiming for this.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: xAI QTS Atlanta; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 1.0. xAI's GPU cluster in the QTS Atlanta building at 1025 Jefferson Street NW is operational around this time. This date is a tentative estimate: Business Insider reported the buildout in February 2025, so the cluster likely came online around or shortly after then, though the exact date is not disclosed. The cluster comprises 11,000 NVIDIA H100 and about 1,448 A100 GPUs, based on documents submitted to Develop Fulton as [reported by Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/xai-elon-musk-x-new-atlanta-data-center-2025-2). xAI occupies part of this multi-tenant building, so its cooling is not attributed to xAI alone.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: Anthropic Barber Lake; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 0.0. Building 1 shell is complete, with rooftop units installed, and most air-cooled chillers in place in a ground yard to the north. Most of the 120 backup diesel generators are also in place. Substantial progress since Nov 2025, still under construction and not yet energized.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: Anthropic Barber Lake; Power (MW); projection
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch projection, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 1.0. Building 1 Phase I is operational: 168 MW critical IT power (244 MW gross), running Google TPU v7 (chip type inferred, tagged likely). We estimate ~Dec 2026, about 3 months later than the disclosed target, because the site is shell-complete but not yet energized as of the Jul 2026 image. Disclosed target: [Cipher 2025-09-25 PR](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/09/25/3156107/0/en/Cipher-Mining-Signs-168-MW-10-Year-AI-Hosting-Agreement-with-Fluidstack.html) states the 168 MW critical IT load is "expected to be delivered by September 2026."

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: Anthropic Barber Lake; Power (MW); projection
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch projection, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 1.0. Building 1 Phase II is operational: 207 MW total critical IT (300 MW gross). Phase II adds 39 MW critical IT (see [Cipher 2025-11-20 PR](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/11/20/3191801/0/en/Cipher-Mining-Signs-Additional-56-MW-10-Year-AI-Hosting-Agreement-with-Fluidstack.html)). We estimate ~Apr 2027, about 3 months later than the ~Q1 2027 target, based on construction progress.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: CoreWeave Muskogee OK; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 0.0. Core Scientific, CoreWeave, and Port Muskogee publicly announce groundbreaking for the 100 MW Muskogee HPC data center. Core Scientific [says](https://investors.corescientific.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/99/core-scientific-and-port-muskogee-break-ground-on-100-mw-hpc-data-center) the site will provide about 70 MW of critical IT load for CoreWeave's NVIDIA GPUs.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: CoreWeave Muskogee OK; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 0.0. Based on satellite imagery, Building 1 looks mostly complete, but the site still appears to be in construction or commissioning. Not much progress has happened in the past 4 months, and a Q2 2026 finish seems unlikely.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: CoreWeave Muskogee OK; Power (MW); reported estimate
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch reported estimate, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 0.0. Based on satellite imagery, Building 1 has completed construction, with adjacent land cleared for what we're assuming will have power substations/generators. We can assume Building 1 is not operational from all the yard work directly surrounding it, and the lack of a parking lot. Building 2 (The one not leased to CoreWeave) is still in land clearing phase.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: CoreWeave Muskogee OK; Power (MW); projection
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch projection, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 1.0. Estimating building 1 is operational by the end of the year, judging from the building currently completed, the completed power substation to the southwest. The surrounding yard work/construction will likely still take several months, judging from the slow pace.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: CoreWeave Muskogee OK; Power (MW); projection
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch projection, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 2.0. Core Scientific expects initial delivery of the second, unleased 82.5 MW Muskogee building in Q4 2027. capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: OpenAI Stargate UAE; Power (MW); projection
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch projection, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 2.0. Building 1 and 2 are operational. The similar data center in Ajman, UAE was delayed by over a year, now due in December 2026 (compare [1](https://khaznadatacenters.com/press-release/khazna-expands-infrastructure-to-accelerate-uaes-leadership-in-artificial-intelligence/), [2](https://khaznadatacenters.com/press-release/khazna-announces-the-uaes-first-ai-optimized-data-center-and-the-largest-in-its-portfolio-powering-the-nations-drive-toward-ai-leadership/)). The buildings here looked 3-6 months behind the Ajman building as of November 2025, but they were moving faster. So we think Building 1 and 2 are on track for 200 MW by December 2026, along with the Ajman building.

capacity_timeline.source: Epoch AI: OpenAI Stargate UAE; Power (MW); projection
capacity_timeline.notes: Epoch projection, not a meter reading. Buildings operational: 10.0. 1 GW of IT power is operational. We haven’t seen expansion beyond 200 MW as of November 2025. Optimistically, 8 more 100 MW buildings start construction in December 2025, in parallel, and take 1.5 years like the first two buildings, hitting 1 GW by Q3 2027. More realistically, there's some staggering of construction over several months, like Stargate Abilene. Our median estimate is January 2028.
